Liveness plus a one-statement probe of the tracker store.

than report `ok` on an instance that cannot persist anything.

project-wide caps so nothing is lost.
Raw answer samples with full text, the engine's queries, claims and snippets.

Spend and volume per vendor; `project_id` narrows to that client's runs.

`exclude_source=demo` leaves seeded demonstration rows out of the totals.
`prompt_id` (with `project_id`) narrows to that prompt's direct engine
calls and reports the run-level remainder separately.

Engine.title: Engine
Engine.description:
AI answer engines the tracker audits.

Values name what was *actually called*, not the consumer product it
approximates — `CHATGPT_SEARCH` is the OpenAI Responses API with the
`web_search` tool, which is the closest programmatic proxy for ChatGPT
Search, not ChatGPT itself.

EngineHealth.title: EngineHealth
EngineHealth.description: One platform's verdict for the project.

EngineStatus.title: EngineStatus
EngineStatus.description:
Why a prompt × platform cell is empty.

Absence has three unrelated causes and they must not render alike: a platform
the project does not track, one it tracks but has never asked, and one that was
asked and failed every time (Gemini's billing 429s account for 41 such pairs).

ProjectCredentials.title: ProjectCredentials
ProjectCredentials.description:
The owner credential that unlocks writes to one project (ADR 0019).

The owner name is public (it is shown beside the lock); the password is not
stored, only its salted digest. A colon is refused in the owner because the
pair travels as `owner:password` in the `X-Project-Authorization` header.

full.title: Full

ProjectRunRecord.description: One crawl of a project: a job that produced at least one pipeline run.

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: Partial update; only supplied fields change.

PromptCapture.title: PromptCapture
PromptCapture.description:
Which rich-capture layers exist for this prompt, so empty tabs can say why.

Capture landed in cycle 0011 and the split is per run: a prompt sampled only
before it has no answer text at all, which is not the same as an answer with no
citations.

run_ids.title: Run Ids
run_ids.description: Runs that sampled this prompt, newest first. Built from the samples themselves, not the project's crawl list, which can omit them.

content_gap.title: Content Gap
content_gap.description: No landing page maps to this prompt's subtopic.

shared_lob_projects.title: Shared Lob Projects
shared_lob_projects.description: Other projects on the same line of business. Prompt history is keyed by (lob, text), so identical prompts in these projects share one series.

PromptDetail.title: PromptDetail
PromptDetail.description:
Everything the control plane knows about one tracked prompt.

Insights are deliberately absent. For them, request `/insights?prompt_id=`,
which applies the scope before the project-wide caps; filtering the unscoped
response on the client loses rows for any prompt outside the top-N and
mis-attributes claims shared between prompts (ADR 0017).

citation_rate.title: Citation Rate

cited_in_minority.title: Cited In Minority
cited_in_minority.description: Cited in at least one sample but below the majority threshold, so `cited` is False while the client genuinely holds a rank.

models.title: Models
models.description: Distinct models behind the series, newest first. A change breaks trend comparability and should be annotated on the chart.
